practiceExercises.question: Why did the dog finally choose Man as his master?
practiceExercises.hint: The Lion was afraid of Man.
practiceExercises.explanation: The dog wanted a master who was the strongest on earth, and he saw even the Lion feared Man.

flashcards.back: More torn or worn out (like a stuck kite)

revisionNotes: The dog found man to be the most powerful master. A kite looks bright when new.
commonMistakes: Confusing the order of masters the dog tried
